description.text:
The deck that won the Junior Division of the 2010 World Championships. Pokémon Collector and Claydol fill the Bench to power up Jumpluff's Mass Attack, Bebe's Search and Pokémon Communication find the evolutions, and Unown R adds damage and a little drawing. The 2010 World Championships were held at the Hilton Waikoloa Village in Waikoloa Village, Hawaii, from 13 to 15 August 2010.

Pokémon sold it as a 2010 World Championships deck: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet and a deck box. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
